title: Make Batch45 child-process teardown proof bounded and decisive
outcome: The Batch45 process-follower test uses only load-bearing process-completion assertions and cannot hang while draining redirected output.
acceptance: The child stdout and stderr reader tasks are drained with an explicit bound before strict workspace deletion, with timeout and non-timeout faults reported honestly.
The redundant child.HasExited assertion is removed or moved behind an operation that can return without proving exit.
The teardown remains bounded if the standalone child ever begins spawning descendants that can inherit redirected pipe handles.
